title: EnvironmentState
description: Deterministic serializable snapshot of micro-habitat conditions applied during a simulation tick

ambient_temperature_celsius.description: Local microclimate temperature in degrees Celsius

substrate_moisture.description: Moisture content of decaying wood or soil substrate

substrate_organic_richness.description: Nutritional and fungal/bacterial richness of the foraging medium

food_density.description: Spatial availability of edible resources within foraging reach

shelter_security_factor.description: Protection index from predation and external physical disturbances

population_crowding_index.description: Conspecific density factor generating competition and interference

environmental_hazard_rating.description: Severity of ambient environmental toxins, flooding, or mold infestation
